name: chesapeake-safe-stop-demo
description: The Chesapeake bloom steps with one injected integrity fault after the first GenBank inventory. Demonstrates a controlled safe stop. Runs without model keys.

steps.query: (Margalefidinium polykrikoides OR Cochlodinium polykrikoides) AND Chesapeake
steps.reason: Find published reports of M. polykrikoides blooms in Chesapeake Bay waters
Count public sequence records and strains for the bloom-forming dinoflagellate
Count public sequence records for the co-occurring dinoflagellate

critiques.reason: the inventory is treated as lacking verified provenance so the stop path can be inspected

gaps: This run demonstrates the safe-stop path; its stop is caused by an injected fault, not a real integrity failure.
